coverage.note:
All 9 SuperSearch paths appear verbatim in the baseline set. The 3 baseline-only paths were verified with fsutil to be NTFS hardlink aliases of the same file records SuperSearch already reported (C:\Windows
otepad.exe and C:\Windows\System32
otepad.exe alias the amd64 WinSxS copy; C:\Windows\SysWOW64
otepad.exe aliases the wow64 WinSxS copy). Per file record, both tools found the same files; per path string, the recursive walk lists 3 extra hardlink aliases. No SuperSearch-only paths.
